tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Page and board background (the desk the cards sit on).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Topic cards, dialogs, panels.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields and wells inside a card or panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons, on desk, card and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Author names, counts, hints and placeholders, on desk, card and sunken.

tokens.usage: Index-card ruling, hairline dividers, timer track. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.usage: Accent used as text (links, ‘Your vote’), on card and desk.

tokens.usage: First sticker-dot colour for votes.

tokens.usage: Second sticker-dot colour.

tokens.usage: Third sticker-dot colour.

tokens.usage: Thin ring round each sticker dot so light dots hold 3:1 on a card.

tokens.usage: Text on a state-ideas fill.

tokens.usage: Text on a state-todiscuss fill.

tokens.name: on-state-discussing

tokens.usage: Delete and remove actions, as text or outline.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an open sheet or dialog, dimming the page.

styles.name: title

styles.sample: Add topics you want to talk about. Everyone gets 3 votes.

tokens.usage: Gap between sticker dots; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; inside chips.

tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between columns on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
